verdict.rationale: Yapily's Account Authorisation flow covers both AIS (accounts, balances, transactions) and identity/account confirmation under a single consent grant, and Yapily Connect provides a single white-label UI for these AIS flows, implying one session can cover multiple data products. However, payments (PIS) are documented as a separate authorisation/consent flow, and there's no explicit documentation confirming a single link session spans both AIS and PIS or that identity confirmation is bundled without a separate re-auth step. missing for 10: explicit documentation of one unified session/consent token covering AIS+PIS+identity simultaneously, and independent/hands-on confirmation that users aren't re-prompted per product.
